text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A four-member delegation from the Labour and Social Affairs Ministry is due to visit Russia on May 25.
- Bahrain is to issue marine survey maps showing navigational channels through its territorial waters.
- A team from Bahrain's Information Ministry left Bahrain for Geneva to participate in a tourism exhibition.
- Bahrain's Shura council agreed to allow nationals of the United Arab Emirates to own real estate in Bahrain.
- The Gulf Petrochemical Industries Co is to pay a total $15 million dividend to shareholders for 1996. It said operating income stood at $52 million last year.
